title: Hefei Institutes of Physical Science, Chinese Academy of Sciences
content:
Hefei Institutes of Physical Science (HFIPS), Chinese Academy of Sciences, established in 2001 in Hefei, is a large integrated research base comprising seven units, including the Institute of Solid State Physics, the Anhui Institute of Optics and Fine Mechanics, and the High Magnetic Field Laboratory.

Its aerogel research is active and well documented: teams led by Prof. Wang Zhenyang and Prof. Zhang Shudong have developed SiC@SiO2 ceramic fiber aerogels with cross-plane thermal conductivity as low as 0.018 W/m·K and stability from -196 °C to 1300 °C, ZrO2-toughened SiO2 fiber aerogels, and flame-retardant biomass aerogels, while Institute of Solid State Physics researchers created carbon-fiber-reinforced aerogel composites that combine high-temperature insulation with load-bearing capability for thermal protection in aerospace and energy systems.
